# MC Close
> Mission Control on a Mac has no close buttons. MC Close adds close, minimize, full-screen and zoom buttons to every window in Mission Control, and shortcuts like ⌘W.

MC Close is a free, open-source (MIT) macOS menu-bar app. Open Mission Control (F3, Control-↑, or a three- or four-finger swipe up) and each window's own title-bar controls light up in its thumbnail: close, minimize, full screen, and zoom (fill the screen without a separate space, like Option-clicking the green button). Point at a window and press ⌘W to close it, ⌘M to minimize, ⌃⌘F for full screen, ⌥⌘F to zoom, ⌘H to hide its app or ⌘Q to quit its app. In Settings you can choose which buttons appear, their order, and their colours (Match System, Multicolor, Graphite or an accent colour).

- Works on macOS 13 Ventura or later, including macOS 27, where Apple moved Mission Control into WindowManager. Apple silicon and Intel.
- Needs Accessibility permission. Only listens to the keyboard and mouse while Mission Control is open.
- If two windows could match a thumbnail, it does nothing rather than close the wrong one.
- Sends nothing about the user; checks GitHub once a month for a new version.
- Not made by or affiliated with Apple.

## Install
curl -fsSL https://github.com/anujbajaj4/fixing_macos/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash

Or download MCClose.dmg from https://github.com/anujbajaj4/fixing_macos/releases/latest
